explanation: On S₄, u=0 and v decreases from 1 to 0. Thus x=v and y=v²=x², an upward-opening parabola traversed from (1,1) to (0,0).

answers.correct_value: An arc of an upward-opening parabola, traversed from $(1,1)$ to $(0,0).$
answers.wrong_value: An arc of an upward-opening parabola, traversed from $(0,0)$ to $(1,1).$
